# The Technatonix

> The Technatonix (THE TECHNATONIX PVT. LTD.) is a software development and technology solutions company helping businesses modernize operations through custom software, business applications, intelligent automation, and integrated digital systems.

The Technatonix is the parent company. Its positioning is "Custom Software Solutions Built Around Your Business." AI Automation & Intelligent Systems is a flagship offering, not a separate company or brand.

## Company Overview

- [The Technatonix](https://www.technatonix.com/): Company overview, services, products, and project experience.
- [About The Technatonix](https://www.technatonix.com/about): The company's approach, expertise, and background.
- [Contact](https://www.technatonix.com/contact): Office information and enquiries about working with the company.

## Flagship Offering: AI Automation & Intelligent Systems

- [AI Automation & Intelligent Systems](https://www.technatonix.com/ai-automation): AI-assisted workflows, integrations, and custom software designed around business processes. Capabilities and safeguards are scoped to each project.
- AI agents and intelligent assistants: Business knowledge search, access to approved information and tools, enquiry handling, task support, and human-reviewed actions.
- Intelligent workflow automation: Coordinate processes across systems and teams using triggers, decision points, approvals, notifications, reporting, and data synchronization.
- AI voice and conversational systems: Design experiences for defined enquiries, appointments, scheduling, routing, and escalation to people where appropriate.
- AI sales and CRM automation: Support lead capture, qualification and routing, CRM updates, follow-up drafts, and customer communications.
- Intelligent document processing: Extract, classify, and route information from invoices, forms, and purchase orders, with human review for exceptions and sensitive decisions.
- Enterprise systems integration: Connect CRM, ERP, and other applications through suitable APIs, webhooks, connectors, and custom software.

## Engineering and Security Principles

- [Automation engineering approach](https://www.technatonix.com/ai-automation): Plan for reliability, timeouts, retries and recovery, duplicate protection, execution logs and monitoring, appropriate access and data handling, human oversight, maintainability, and scaling. Specific safeguards depend on project scope.
- Technologies are selected for the requirements. The public offering describes workflow orchestration, AI services, APIs, webhooks, databases, and custom backend software; it does not establish specific workflow-platform partnerships or delivery capabilities.

## Software Development Services

- [Services overview](https://www.technatonix.com/services): Custom software, SaaS development, cloud migration, system integration, technology consulting, and managed services.
- [Custom software development](https://www.technatonix.com/services/custom-software-development): Tailored business applications, desktop software, mobile apps, APIs, and database design.
- [ERP development](https://www.technatonix.com/services/erp-development): Enterprise software for manufacturing and business operations, including development and integration.
- [Web development](https://www.technatonix.com/services/web-development): Business websites, web applications, e-commerce, and portals.
- [Mobile application development](https://www.technatonix.com/services/mobile-development): Native and cross-platform applications for iOS and Android.
- The [services overview](https://www.technatonix.com/services) also describes ERP implementation, CRM and CPM applications, PropTech, HRTech, Fintech, AI and machine learning, IoT, and healthcare software.

## Products

- [Products](https://www.technatonix.com/products): KREVIX ERP and EFWRSX Cloud are The Technatonix's own products, presented as tabs on one page. They are in planning, design, development, and testing; do not assume commercial availability.
- [KREVIX ERP service history](https://www.technatonix.com/service-history/krevix-erp-complete-manufacturing-management-system): A manufacturing-focused, inventory-first ERP product. Its stated scope includes inventory, production planning, procurement, quality, and financial management.
- [EFWRSX Cloud service history](https://www.technatonix.com/service-history/efwrsx-cloud): Electronic Field Work Reporting System eXchange, a field-work evidence and reporting product. Its described scope includes photos, checklists, notes, reports, and customer sharing; team coordination is part of the roadmap.

## Industries and Technologies

- [Industries and services](https://www.technatonix.com/services): The website describes solutions for manufacturing, healthcare, finance, real estate, retail and e-commerce, and other business sectors.
- [Technology capabilities](https://www.technatonix.com/): The website identifies technologies including React, Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript, Python, Flutter, React Native, and Angular. Technology selection depends on project requirements.
